revision.reason: Upstream review found the frozen matrix-A cancellation positive fixture was internally inconsistent (run record session 'sess-proj' vs DTO session 'sess-cancel'), and Root reproduced pure/projection identity escapes. This delivery corrects that fixture and pins each escape as an independent negative. No production code and no shared registration file is touched.
corrections: Cancellation projection positive now passes the explicit record session 'sess-cancel' as projectionRunRecord's third argument and asserts the projected observation session equals the actual record session; production may not use the DTO's own session as the expected identity to make a mismatched positive pass.
Adapter resume case now asserts the run record's sessionId and threadId both persist the learned current stream session, so the old resume hint cannot survive into archive binding.
addedAcceptanceCases: pure: session identity is exact (' s ' vs 's' must not be trim-merged) and blank runId/missionId never yield an observed response
pure: bind refuses observed DTOs carrying error reasons; conflict DTOs whose observations contain a model not listed in models; duplicate observation event indexes
pure: duplicate evidence differing only by object key order is one run and is counted exactly once
projection: a run record/DTO bound to a foreign mission never projects into the current mission
projection: a cancelled run whose DTO session disagrees with the record is refused while the release receipt stays authoritative
projection: a run record claiming provider codex-cli never projects a claude-code observation
projection: a failing readRun clears the previously projected observation instead of leaving stale evidence
revision.expectedBaseline: red — the main tree has no client-runtime/model-observation.mjs and no adapter/projection/archive integration; all 27 original semantics plus these added negatives execute, and the corrected cancellation fixture no longer passes on a session mismatch.

registrationPolicy: test author delivers only tests/model-observation-test.mjs plus this isolated manifest; a later single writer registers the npm script, both verification gates and tests/README.md. No shared file is edited by this delivery.
hardwareFreeStatement: The test never starts a real Claude CLI, Python runner, network call or GPU process. The Claude adapter is driven through an injected fake child process, and agent-runtime/archive are driven through injected clients and real pure state entry points.

tests.owner: response model observation (adapter + pure API + runtime projection + archive)
tests.readmeDescription: `model-observation-test.mjs` is the independent acceptance for the frozen response-model observation contract in `docs/development/MODEL_OBSERVATION_ACCEPTANCE.md` (matrix A). It dynamically imports the new pure `client-runtime/model-observation.mjs` so a missing module is reported as `MODEL_OBSERVATION_API_MISSING` rather than a loader crash, then drives the real `createClaudeClient` with an injected fake child stream (matching response observation, resume hint not observed, init-only/empty unknown, blank/synthetic unknown, mixed models conflict, foreign/missing sessions, mixed completeness where a valid response is followed by a missing/blank/synthetic model or a missing session and must not be promoted to observed, thinking-only metadata without thinking leakage, unterminated final JSON line, cancellation retention, JSON round trip), the real `createAgentRuntime({ mode: 'claude-code' })` projection (exact current run/mission/session/provider binding, metadata-only change with unchanged status/event count, run/mission/session/provider-foreign and missing bindings clear the stale value, cancellation settlement retains the observation without weakening the release receipt) and the real `createMissionProjectState(...).resetMissionRunState` archive path (bound value preserved as a detached `runHistory[].modelObservation`, live run cleared, run/mission/session/provider-foreign observation bindings refused instead of archived, new run inherits nothing). Pure bind coverage includes observation-backed conflict DTOs (one matching observation per model, distinct event indexes) and rejects conflict DTOs whose `models` have no observations or only partial/foreign-session evidence. It is hardware-free and starts no real Claude, Python or GPU process; it runs in both verification gates. It is written before the implementation and is expected to be red until `client-runtime/model-observation.mjs` exists and the adapter/projection/archive semantics are implemented; it must not be weakened to accept a partial implementation.

reasons: client-runtime/model-observation.mjs does not exist: dynamic import fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND and all pure API checks (including the added revision-2 negatives) report MODEL_OBSERVATION_API_MISSING.
The Claude adapter does not persist record.modelObservation (matching/resume/thinking/conflict/foreign/synthetic/mixed-completeness/cancellation checks fail on the missing field).

claude-client.mjs drops the unterminated final JSON line: the close-flush closure captures the mutable `eventBuffer` variable and writes an empty line after it is cleared, so the final no-newline event is lost (verified with a scratch probe under .scratch-model-test/).

agent-runtime does not project state.agent.modelObservation for the current run, so both metadata-only change and stale-clearing checks fail; no run/mission/session/provider binding check is implemented, so wrongly bound observations would survive.
resetMissionRunState does not archive modelObservation into runHistory[], does not clear the live value and does not refuse run/mission/session/provider-foreign observation bindings.
